title: Ensure AAP Inventory with Hosts
description: Ensure an AAP organization, inventory, and optionally a group with hosts (or hosts directly in the inventory) exist in the controller.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: aap_gateway_ip
parameters.description: The IP address or hostname of the AAP controller gateway.

parameters.name: aap_user
parameters.description: The username used to authenticate to the AAP controller.

parameters.name: aap_password
parameters.description: The password used to authenticate to the AAP controller.

parameters.name: organization_name
parameters.description: The name of the organization to ensure exists.

parameters.name: inventory_name
parameters.description: The name of the inventory to ensure exists in the organization.

parameters.name: group_name
parameters.description: Optional group name to ensure exists in the inventory. When provided, hosts are added to this group.

parameters.name: hosts_list
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated list of host names to ensure present in the inventory (or group when group_name is provided).

playbook_output.description: Emits organization_name, inventory_name, group_name, hosts_list, and a status message.

fields.name: organization_name
fields.description: The name of the organization that was ensured.

fields.name: inventory_name
fields.description: The name of the inventory that was ensured.

fields.name: group_name
fields.description: The name of the group that was ensured, or empty if no group was provided.

fields.name: hosts_list
fields.description: The comma-separated list of hosts that were ensured, or empty if none were provided.

fields.name: status
fields.description: A status message indicating the outcome of the operation.

steps.name: Ensure the organization exists
steps.function: Create the organization if it does not already exist.

steps.name: Ensure the inventory exists
steps.function: Create the inventory in the organization if it does not already exist.

steps.name: Was a group name provided?
steps.function: Branch on whether the caller supplied a group name.
steps.condition: A group name was provided by the caller.

steps.name: Ensure the group and its hosts exist
steps.function: Create the group in the inventory if missing, and ensure the provided hosts are members of the group while preserving existing members.

steps.name: Were hosts provided?
steps.function: Branch on whether the caller supplied a hosts list.
steps.condition: Hosts were provided by the caller.

steps.name: Ensure hosts exist directly in the inventory
steps.function: Create each provided host directly in the inventory if it does not already exist.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the Required Output Format <result> block on success.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Ensure the organization and inventory exist before applying host or group changes.

phases.name: Main action
phases.description: Ensure the group and hosts (or hosts directly in the inventory) exist based on the provided inputs.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the structured final result to the caller.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
